risks.title: Complete absence of risk disclosure specific to the entity
risks.score_rationale: Stated on the first page of the Strategic Report: 'The principal risks and uncertainties of the Group… are not managed separately.' The language is explicit and deliberate. Trend remains stable (permanent holding structure). Regulatory category applies as the Companies Act 2006 requires adequate risk disclosure in the strategic report.

risks.title: Total dependence on parent company Schroders plc for all operations
risks.score_rationale: The report explicitly states zero employees, directors remunerated by other group subsidiaries, and audits paid by the parent company. The entity has no operational autonomy. Trend remains stable. High weight given that any failure or restructuring of Schroders plc would directly impact this entity.

risks.title: Concentration risk: single activity as group health insurance vehicle
risks.score_rationale: Note 2 reveals that 100% of revenues (£7,997,757) derive exclusively from intragroup health insurance premium reimbursement. No business diversification. Trend trending up as premiums increased +21% between 2023 and 2024, signaling rising exposure to a single insurance provider.

risks.title: Critical dependency on single undisclosed health insurance provider
risks.score_rationale: Note 3 references 'the health insurance provider' (singular, unidentified), representing 100% of costs. No mention of alternative contracts or continuity clauses. Trend remains stable. Concentration with a single undisclosed vendor constitutes a supply continuity risk.

risks.title: Regulatory risk related to OECD Pillar Two framework (global minimum tax)
risks.score_rationale: Note 4 explicitly references the effective date of January 1, 2024 for the 15% global minimum tax rate under the OECD Pillar Two framework. Although impact is deemed immaterial for this entity, risk of recharacterization or regulatory framework evolution remains real. Trend is new (first mentioned in 2024).

risks.title: Absence of autonomous governance and Companies Act compliance risk
risks.score_rationale: The report indicates KPIs are 'not necessary or appropriate' for this entity, and governance is entirely delegated to Schroders plc. The Companies Act 2006 imposes strategic reporting obligations on private companies. Trend remains stable. Non-compliance risk exists if regulators challenge the adequacy of the strategic report.

risks.title: Reputational risk through association with Schroders plc group
risks.score_rationale: The entity shares the historic 'J. Henry Schroder Wagg' brand (founded 1804) and is entirely dependent on the reputation of Schroders plc. Any reputational incident affecting the group (sanctions, litigation, governance scandals) would directly impact this entity. Trend remains stable.
